crew.overview: Melvin Udall, a cranky, bigoted, obsessive-compulsive writer of romantic fiction, is rude to everyone he meets, including his gay neighbor, Simon. After Simon is brutally attacked and hospitalized, Melvin finds his life turned upside down when he has to look after Simon's dog. In addition, Carol, the only waitress at the local diner who will tolerate him, leaves work to care for her chronically ill son, making it impossible for Melvin to eat breakfast.
crew.title: As Good as It Gets

details.biography:
Julia Davis is a Ukrainian-born producer, director, screenwriter in the film and television industry. Julia is a featured Russian Expert at the Atlantic Council, Disinformation Portal, a member of the Academy of Arts & Sciences, Screen Actors Guild, Women In Film, listed as one of Top 40 Ukrainian Producers, Directors, Writers, a member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officers Association and other prestigious guilds, unions and organizations.  Julia earned a Master's Degree in Aviation and Spacecraft Engineering. She is multilingual and speaks several languages fluently, including English, Spanish, Russian (native speaker) and Ukrainian (native speaker). Julia studied basic Farsi at Cal-State Northridge, CA.

Julia Davis became a National Security/Counter-Terrorism/Immigration/Russian Propaganda Expert as a former federal officer, having served with the Department of Homeland Security/ Customs and Border Protection as an Acting Supervisor while being processed for employment as a Special Agent for the Federal Bureau of Investigation.  Julia is an internationally-known Russian Media Analyst. She created the website "Russian Media Monitor," which actively debunks propaganda and monitors Russian media. Julia writes as an Investigative Reporter, discussing foreign policy, international and domestic affairs and other issues.  Julia's investigative reports and articles have prompted retractions and corrections by RT (formerly Russia Today) and other media outlets, globally showcased.  Julia Davis is a former DHS, Customs & Border Protection, Law Enforcement Agent, featured on prime-time news outlets, "The Doctors", "Access Hollywood", "Good Morning America", "Inside Edition", "Entertainment Tonight", "CNN", "HLN", "Nancy Grace" commentator on Fox News - "Fox News - Follow the Money" with Eric Bolling, HLN's "Nancy Grace", with commentary on national security, immigration, corruption, counter-terrorism, human rights, civil rights and due process.  Julia works in support of charitable organizations, such as Wounded Warriors Chapter, Therapeutic Living Center for the Blind (sponsored by the Conrad Hilton Foundation), American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals and Humane Society.  During her career years in the film industry, Julia Davis served as a stunt double to Academy Award winners Angelina Jolie and Helen Hunt, working in the international film franchise, "The Amazing Spider-Man 2" and knows production from all aspects, from concept to delivery. Julia's creative experience is vast, as an accredited producer, director, investigative reporter, award winning screenwriter and published author. Julia produced the first American film score utilizing the talent of the world renowned National Ukrainian Orchestra for Paramount Pictures.

Julia's articles have been cited by CNN, The Hill, International Business Times, The Hollywood Reporter, People, Cosmopolitan, Time Magazine, The Wrap, Entertainment Weekly, US Magazine, E!-Online, New York Daily News, Radar Online, Yahoo Movies, Inside Edition, MTV, Huffington Post, Miami Herald, The Guardian, MSN, Mirror, The Inquisitr, The International Business Times, Metro (UK), Wall Street Journal and Dallas News.  Julia Davis is the CEO of Fleur De Lis Film Studios for domestic and international productions, sales and distribution for all media markets.
